_doc: RC-2 closed capability vocabulary — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the two token axes used by universal adaptive advisor selection. `signals` are stack-fingerprint tokens: the fingerprinter (web/scripts/fingerprint.ts) EMITS a subset of these from a workspace, and each advisor's meta.yaml `capabilities.signals` DECLARES the subset it covers; a seat scores on the intersection. `domains` are feature-brief expertise tags: an advisor's `capabilities.domains` declares its lane, scored against the feature brief. Any token in a fingerprint OR a meta.yaml capability profile that is NOT listed here MUST fail the verifier (a typo that silently never-matches is the failure mode this file exists to make impossible). Tokens are lowercase-normalised at both emit and load. `any` is the reserved cross-stack signal — an advisor declaring it (e.g. hunt, fowler) is eligible on every fingerprint and scored purely by domain relevance. Adding a token here is the deliberate, reviewable act of teaching the council a new stack signal or expertise lane; see specs/council-universal-adaptive-advisor-selection.md (RC-2).
